name: Intercoastal Electronics EMS
old_description: Intercoastal specializes in complex builds that combine SMT, through-hole, fine-pitch, and specialty components. Our team manages challenging layouts and thermal/mechanical constraints to ensure robust, high-reliability assemblies.
about:
Intercoastal Electronics EMS operates from Rockledge, Florida, as a full-service electronics contract manufacturer. The company focuses on complex printed circuit board assemblies that combine surface-mount, through-hole, fine-pitch, and specialty component technologies.

Its manufacturing services span prototype through low-to-mid-volume production, including SMT and through-hole PCB assembly, complex mixed-technology builds, system-level box build, inspection, conformal coating, and rework/repair. The firm also provides engineering support and component reconditioning, positioning itself as a partner for high-mix, flexible-volume programs.

The customer base comprises OEMs, engineering teams, and product developers seeking reliable, repeatable electronic assembly for commercial non-regulated products. Intercoastal emphasizes supply-chain continuity and overflow manufacturing, offering transparent quoting and production planning without hidden costs.

The company highlights its IPC-certified assembly and inspection processes as a quality differentiator, along with a disciplined approach that bridges prototype and production phases. Flexible capacity and expertise in challenging thermal and mechanical constraints are cited as reasons customers partner with Intercoastal.
